title: beta-hero-stellar-art-evidence-v615
implementation: Added V615 deterministic Beta hero art evidence pack for all 24 stellar heroes, sourced from the sealed V592 hero catalog and V607 SIMBAD projection without changing measurement payloads.

Separated the 20 current runtime baseline stars from Acrux, Spica, Regulus and Polaris candidate-only records; candidate records retain parameterized photosphere/corona presentation metadata but cannot enter the runtime allowlist.

Added per-record checks for identity, photometry, geometry, shader profile, corona model, presentation boundary and source reference, plus blocker-derived next gates and deterministic review fingerprints.
Added fail-closed CLI generation and tests for hero packet seal changes, visual field tampering, reordered output, opened measurement writeback and opened runtime admission.
Extended the Beta hero review panel with the 20/24 art baseline summary and selected-candidate V615 checklist, explicitly showing parameterized photosphere status and remaining source/runtime gates.
